gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-syloti: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, with wide gaps bridging the strokes and a loud, expressive shape. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri keeps quiet, short ascenders and a lower bowl that breathes.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Loud and stencilled, Snowburst One makes a statement with its wide bridges and sprung-open curves. And Noto Sans Syriac lets lowercase bowls swell like blown glass, with s turns that glide easily along the line.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tagalo: Noto Sans Tagalog lets its middle zone dominate each line, with curves that keep generous gaps. And Snowburst One supplies the punch, a stencilled display face that makes the quiet body feel even calmer.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tagban: Stencil cuts and sprung-open curves give Snowburst One a bold, expressive look from the first glance. Noto Sans Tagbanwa follows with clear gaps in its curves and lowercase that fills most of the line's height.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Snowburst One is a stencilled display face with wide bridges and bold attitude. Noto Sans Tai Le hands over ink strokes that taper out before they touch, and a small step from capitals to lowercase keeps a long read smooth.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-th: Chalk-board lowercase crowds toward the capital line here, with open c shapes you can see into. Snowburst One brings the stencilled, wide-bridged shout while Noto Sans Tai Tham stays contemporary and low-key beneath it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-vi: Noto Sans Tai Viet pairs short ascenders with a big x-height, and its terminals pull back from where each curve would close. But Snowburst One, stencilled and loud, gives the heading all the bold swagger a reader's eye would need.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri leaves every small round letter generously unclosed, over a high-waisted lowercase that feels modern. Snowburst One, by contrast, does its best work with stencil bridges and bold display attitude, while Noto Sans Takri handles the quieter text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Stencil bridges run wide between the letters of Snowburst One, which gives the heading its bold, expressive punch. Noto Sans Tamil does the opposite job, looking magnified at ordinary size with terminals that stop far from the stem.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil-: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement draws round forms like open parentheses, in a middle band so deep the line looks stocky. Its real strength is the clash with Snowburst One, a stencilled, bold display face.
